clue.text: Holds up dispatches about American power

indicators.note: about means going round, so the word for dispatches wraps the other letters

parts.note: to dispatch a letter is to send it
P is the physics symbol for power

explanation.surface: Someone delays sending off messages concerning US might.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold up a meeting is to halt it for a while, a synonym of the verb.

clue.text: Slow speed of house conveyancer

parts.note: a house conveyancer is a property lawyer, but cryptically the creature that carries its shell, its house, on its back

explanation.surface: A complaint about a sluggish property solicitor.
explanation.walkthrough: A conveyancer is a lawyer handling house sales, so the surface is a gripe about slow lawyers.
explanation.definitionFit: The crawl of the shell-bearing garden mollusc is the idiom for a very slow rate.

clue.text: Improve speed of download online

parts.note: to stream is to download media continuously over the internet
on line, read as a line

explanation.surface: Making internet downloads faster.
explanation.definitionFit: To make something sleeker and more efficient, so it runs or moves faster, is to streamline it.

clue.text: Vantage point, one adopted by Jane

indicators.note: adopted by means taken in, so the surname surrounds the letter

parts.note: Jane Eyre is Charlotte Bronte's heroine
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An orphan girl adopted by a heroine called Jane, seen from a lookout.
explanation.walkthrough: Jane Eyre, an orphan herself, makes 'adopted' apt.
explanation.definitionFit: An eagle's nest is set high on a crag, so the word also means a lofty lookout.

clue.text: Tackling headstands, us? A sad disappointment

indicators.note: tackling suggests attacking and wrestling the letters into a new shape

explanation.surface: Gymnasts attempting headstands, and it ends in sorrow.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that turns to ashes in the mouth is a bitter letdown; the phrase means utter disappointment.

clue.text: Lots to go with the horn?

definitions.meaning: lots means an abundance, a great deal
the horn of ..., or cornucopia, is the classical symbol of abundance; the missing word completes the phrase

explanation.surface: A question about what accompanies a horn, perhaps in music.
explanation.definitionFit: A plentiful supply is lots of something; the cornucopia is called the horn of plenty.

clue.text: Where a tricky problem has had a good kicking?

definitions.text: Where a tricky problem has had a good kicking?

parts.words: Where a tricky problem has had a good kicking?
parts.note: an awkward issue is 'kicked into' rough uncut turf when it is shelved, as a ball might be

explanation.surface: A question about where a hard problem was given a beating.
explanation.walkthrough: To kick an issue into touch in this way means to postpone dealing with it indefinitely.
explanation.definitionFit: Politicians kick awkward issues into the rough to defer them, so that is where such problems lie.

clue.text: Part of speech advocating abolition of New York body

parts.note: a campaign to abolish something is a 'No' campaign
the United Nations has its headquarters in New York

explanation.surface: A speech calling for an end to a New York organisation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Part of speech' looks like part of a speech made at the UN; it is the grammar term.
explanation.definitionFit: A word naming a person, place or thing is one of the grammatical word classes.

clue.text: Repeatedly, you almost bounce up and down

indicators.note: repeatedly means the shortened word is written twice
almost means the word falls one letter short of complete

parts.note: taken as written before shortening

explanation.surface: An exasperated plea to stop someone jumping about.
explanation.definitionFit: To move up and down repeatedly, like the toy on a string, is to yo-yo.

clue.text: Spray that, it's commonly said, can smooth your locks

indicators.note: commonly said points to a common, dropped-H pronunciation of the words that follow

parts.note: a brush for the hair smooths one's locks

explanation.surface: An aerosol that claims to tame your hair.
explanation.walkthrough: The H-dropping of casual London speech turns the hair tool into the artist's spray gun.
explanation.definitionFit: An airbrush is a device that sprays paint with compressed air.

clue.text: Damage on panel

parts.note: in can mean on, as in on duty or in office
a jury is a panel of people judging a case

explanation.surface: Harm reported to a committee.
explanation.definitionFit: Hurt or harm done to a person is an injury, a near synonym for damage.

clue.text: Offer that spoils a so far clear round

definitions.meaning: the right to be asked first before anyone else is given a chance to buy

definitions.text: that spoils a so far clear round
definitions.meaning: in showjumping a horse refusing a fence for the first time costs penalty points in a round that was clean

explanation.surface: A proposal that ruins a faultless round.
explanation.walkthrough: In showjumping a 'refusal' is a horse stopping at a fence, which ends a clear round.
explanation.definitionFit: A buyer given the first chance to purchase holds an option; in showjumping, the first balk mars a round.

clue.text: Saying goodbye, going on holiday

definitions.meaning: taking leave from work, read with the words swapped round

explanation.surface: Bidding farewell as you set off on a break.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal farewell is called a leave-taking; leave also means time off work.

clue.text: Mother's fish served with a single cheese

parts.note: Ma is mother, and the possessive adds S
a carp is a freshwater fish
a single means one

explanation.surface: Mum's fish comes with one piece of cheese.
explanation.definitionFit: Mascarpone is a soft Italian cream cheese used in tiramisu.

clue.text: Remarkable prettiness is long lasting

indicators.note: remarkable suggests the letters are altered into something unusual

explanation.surface: A striking beauty that endures.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that continues over a prolonged period without letting up is enduring.

clue.text: Plan to screen one experimental programme

indicators.note: to screen is to hide behind, so the word for plan surrounds the next letter

parts.note: a plot is a plan or scheme
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A scheme to show a trial TV episode on screen.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilot is a trial episode made to test a television series.

clue.text: On the other hand, afterwards gets at least some profit

parts.note: then means afterwards, next in time
the article a means one, at least some of something
a gain is a profit

explanation.surface: Later, someone makes at least a small profit.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase introduces a contrasting point, an idiom equivalent to but conversely.

clue.text: Various ideas, part worked out

indicators.note: worked out suggests the letters are reworked into a new order

explanation.surface: Assorted thoughts, partly figured out.
explanation.definitionFit: Disparate things are fundamentally different, so a disparate group is a varied one.

clue.text: Edward, for one, who owned up

definitions.meaning: Edward the ... was an eleventh-century English king

explanation.walkthrough: Edward the Confessor, king of England before 1066, was so named for his piety.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who admits a sin or crime confesses; the Anglo-Saxon king bore that title.

clue.text: Dismisses sound of instrument

indicators.note: sound of says the word for the instrument is heard, not spelt

parts.note: a sax, short for saxophone, is a musical instrument

explanation.surface: A boss fires someone over the noise of their music.
explanation.definitionFit: To sack a worker is informal for firing them from a job.

clue.text: A case for the new member of the pack

indicators.note: new tells us to make something fresh of these letters by reordering them

explanation.surface: Arguing that a newcomer should join the group.
explanation.walkthrough: The pack is a pack of playing cards, not a group of people or wolves.
explanation.definitionFit: The highest card of a suit in a deck is one of the fifty-two cards in it.

clue.text: Man taking some red wine

indicators.note: taking some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A fellow helping himself to a glass of claret.
explanation.definitionFit: Edwin is a man's given name; any male name can stand for man in crosswords.

clue.text: Prize tree that's on hand

definitions.meaning: the ... is the honour of victory, as in bearing the ...
the inner surface of the hand

explanation.surface: A treasured tree that is readily available.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a victor's award, a tropical tree, and the inside of the hand.

clue.text: Small girl one didn't want delivered

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing
Pam is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A little girl that nobody wanted brought to them.
explanation.definitionFit: Junk email is unsolicited, sent to inboxes though no one asked for it.

clue.text: Please ask for help to challenge decision

definitions.meaning: to please is to charm or attract
to take a ruling to a higher court or the referee

explanation.surface: A player begs officials to reconsider a ruling.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means attraction, a plea, and a request to overturn a ruling, so it fits all three.

clue.text: Gap made by cutter, altogether?

parts.note: a cut made with a saw is a saw cut; here the hole is one made by a saw, with the article in front
a hole is a gap

explanation.surface: A query about an opening cut by a blade.
explanation.walkthrough: Respace the letters: a saw hole, a gap a cutting tool makes, reads as the phrase meaning in total.
explanation.definitionFit: Taken in full, considering everything together, is an idiom meaning altogether.

clue.text: Second in importance

definitions.meaning: a second is a very brief instant of time
as in a matter of great ..., a matter of significance

explanation.surface: Coming next in rank.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a brief instant and also significance, as in 'of great moment'.

clue.text: Mournful dope engaged by factory

indicators.note: engaged by means held inside, so the word for factory holds the other piece

parts.note: a plant is an industrial factory
dope is slang for information, as is gen

explanation.surface: A sad tale of drugs being employed at an industrial site.
explanation.definitionFit: Plangent describes a loud, plaintive, melancholy sound, so it means sorrowful.
